Normal WhatsApp और Business WhatsApp में क्या अंतर है? Raat ko customer ka message aaya, subah tak woh kisi aur se saamaan le chuka tha. Business WhatsApp free hai. Badalne se pehle ye 3 baatein jaan lijiye. 📱

1. Business profile: dukaan ka pata, khulne ka time aur aap kya bechte hain. Customer ko baar baar poochna nahi padta. Website ya Instagram ka link bhi wahin daal dijiye.

2. Apne aap jawab: dukaan band ho to away message jaata hai. Naya customer aaye to greeting message. Customer ko lagta hai koi sun raha hai.

3. Number aur chats: number wahi rehta hai. Pehle chats ka backup lijiye, phir Business app mein wahi number daaliye. Ek baar shift kiya to chats wapas normal WhatsApp mein nahi jaatin.

Save kar lijiye, aur us dost ko bhejiye jo abhi bhi normal WhatsApp par hai. Comment mein bataiye, aap kaun sa WhatsApp chalate hain? 👇
